line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.3: Insane mode reduces recycle factor by 20%.
* Mordan9 - Better default recycling from Capital Shipyard
* Add-Ons 1.2: Get the number of planets with the recycler effect. Each recycler gives 10% more recycling factor and 10% more research, stacking additively with other recyclers.
* Check that we really have the stuff we want to recycle.
* Get costs. (Add-Ons 1.6.1: Recycling never takes supply into consideration - supply is used to increase building costs.)
* The recycling part.
* Also strip the ship if it exists, and recycle the wares for AI.
* Ship identifiers are determined here while the ship is present.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Lasers and shields are recycled for the AI to use. The payout is negligible however.
* This adds people back to the outpost, when you recycle a ship.
* MordanC - Recycling Yaki ships now only gives minimum people. This fixes exploit.
* Add-Ons 1.9.7: Assimilator perk: +20% more pops from non-Terraformer ships.
* Undock docked ships.
* Remove the wares we've recycled.
* *** Player's reverse engineering ***
* Add-Ons 2.1: Kha'ak Hive Quest.
* The stages are:
* - NULL (not yet started)
* - Found (ship recycled; player's curiosity leads to the hive sector)
* - Terraformed (hive planet terraformed; a large Kha'ak raid will spawn)
* - Completed (raid defeated; player has completed the quest)
* - Failed (raid killed player's Outpost)
* The player begins this quest by recycling a Kha'ak ship. If the Hive exists (a planet with the Hive effect) and the quest has not yet been started, then the quest will start.
* Starting quest message.

line.text: 'Terraform the planet containing the Ancient Kha'ak Hive in '
'. Prepare your defenses before completing the project.'

line.comment: * MordanC - Adjust to a tiered system:
* Now, it will take 3 ships to get up to 75% progress, but you can go further and progress up to 85% now with Recycling.
* Also, advanced ships can now give progress, but only up to 50%.
* Herobetty: OCV playthroughs do not allow research.
* Add-Ons 1.0: Fixed bug with recycling returning flat values rather than percentage-based values.
* Add-Ons 1.2: No research progress for kha'ak ships.
* Add-Ons 1.3: No research progress for TS/TP on insane difficulty.
* Add-Ons 1.5.6: No research progress for Phanon ships. They cannot be boarded anyway but can be recycled if they occasionally bail!
* Add-Ons 2.0: Added prototype variant.
* Determine the reverse engineering cap. 50% for advanced ships, 70% for protoypes, 85% otherwise.
* Progress at -1 means that the project is already completed. We want to add progress if the project has less than the cap.
* Current Progress % Progress % to add (max value)
* 51-85 10, with cap at 85
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: Fix underflow.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Recyclers give +10% more research for each recycler this sector has.
* Cap reverse engineered progress. Caps are 85% for normal, 70% for prototype, 50% for advanced.
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='AmountToAdd: %s, Project Cost: %s, Progress: %s', $amountToAdd, $project.cost, $progress, null, null
